notes.title: About loading times
notes.notes:
Hey all! This is our first alpha experiment and may have some bugs. If you can't proceed, try restarting the app. But there also may be longer loading times between scenes - after each scene, data will be transmitted to our server at Vanderbilt. It may take 1-2 minutes (especially if outside USA), but the scene will progress after the batch upload. 

Thank you for helping to advance our research and contributing to science! We hope to use this data to develop free therapy for social anxiety.
